parts.name: Blade Handle Set (Left)
parts.Basic_description: This is one half of the scissor assembly, consisting of a metal blade and a plastic handle. It is part of the cutting mechanism and provides one side of the grip.
parts.Functional_description: It works together with the other blade handle set to perform cutting actions. The blade provides the cutting edge, while the handle allows the user to apply force comfortably.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the central screw pivot relative to the other blade handle set to open and close the scissors.

parts.name: Blade Handle Set (Right)
parts.Basic_description: This is the other half of the scissor assembly, also consisting of a metal blade and a plastic handle. It forms the complementary side of the cutting and gripping mechanism.
parts.Functional_description: It pairs with the left blade handle set to create a shearing action for cutting materials. The handle is ergonomically shaped for user comfort and control.
parts.Movement_description: It pivots around the screw joint, moving in opposition to the other blade handle set to perform the cutting motion.

parts.name: Screw
parts.Basic_description: This is the central screw that connects the two blade handle sets together, allowing them to pivot.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the pivot point and maintains the alignment and tension between the two blades, ensuring smooth cutting motion.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed in place during normal use but allows rotational movement of the two blade handle sets around its axis.
